notes:
FMC Media PC 0.3.11 — KMMovies and Direct source browser

- Added KMMovies as a built-in Direct provider, with public ZIP-ZAP/R2 and SKYDROP resolution. No TorBox key is needed for these links.
- Direct now uses a provider sidebar like Arabic Sources. Select a provider to see its servers, quality buttons and sizes; encoded, 10-bit and Remux editions remain separate. Choose a quality, then Play.
- Shows provider loading, unavailable and empty states without replacing the provider being viewed as other searches finish. Filtering remains available.
- Matches title, year, media type and explicit season/episode identity; season archives are excluded. Generates a fresh link for each selection and validates video bytes and the supplied filename. Failed R2 links can fall back to the other supported host of the same release.
- Preserves Torrent, Debrid, Arabic Sources, installed addons, keys and library settings.

Validation: 69 Python tests and 35 UI/model tests passed. Browser interactions verified the selected 720p release stays selected after changing providers and is passed to Play. The packaged source engine returned 10 Direct releases and opened a real MKV response with HTTP 206, without TorBox.

Release labels and available files are supplied by the provider. Some third-party hosts may be unavailable or require website verification; those are not used as automatic fallbacks.

Install over the current version without uninstalling.
